b: I am extremely bad with money and leveraging "getting in on the ground floor".
I started mining Bitcoin in 2011 when it was under $1. I bought Ethereum in 2014 and many times since. I'm American and have worked standard tech jobs since I was 18.

Since ~2014, after discovering SSC/LW, I have been near-cultishly faithful that ASI would likely arrive in my lifetime. Since 2022 I thought it'd be by ~2031. I still believe it likely will be. For years I've gotten into tens of thousands of debates on every internet medium you can imagine, arguing in favor of rapid AI timelines.

I stopped mining Bitcoin after a few days, figuring I was losing more in electricity bills than I was making. The little I did have, I spent on shitty Silk Road weed. I 3x'd my Ethereum buy, but my initial input was like $200. My tech jobs have been lame and low-paying and unfulfilling. I've had no startup ideas with any feasible monetization path. I don't really have spare money I can put into NVDA or whatever.

Let's say you time travel to 2034 and you learn RSI really kicked off in late 2027 and you see we have ASI and it's changed everything and is seemingly aligned and no catastrophes have occurred. You travel back to today. How could you benefit from this situation?
(Assume you're not dumb yet you're not smart and competent enough to work at one of the frontier labs.)
I know many others besides me have similar timelines, but I feel I would still have no way to benefit even if this position were far rarer.

If it is indeed the case I am "clairvoyantly" ahead of the curve on one of the most important milestones in human history, surely there is something I could do with this foreknowledge - and yet I can't think of anything.
